articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Improvements

Improved stability.

Bugfixes

Fixed Client Device Isolation not being enforced on some wireless networks.

Additional information
Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.

If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.

If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
articles.title: UniFi Access Point for U7-LR 8.0.76

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is only for these models:

U6-LR/U6-Lite/U6+
UAP-nanoHD/FlexHD/BeaconHD/IW-HD

Improvements

Added Test & Confirm mode to automatically revert configuration changes if the device becomes unreachable or the test period expires without confirmation.

Bugfixes

Fixed clients failing to receive an IP address after changing an Enterprise WiFi network to Open.
Fixed certain 2.4 GHz IoT devices repeatedly reconnecting while appearing connected.
Fixed an issue where U6-LR could report unusually high channel utilization.

Additional information
Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.

If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.

----
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
